title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — September 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.0 (Peaked September 22, 2026 at 04:51 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 305 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Nothing unusual at the moment. 💛

A broad dark coronal-hole-like region spans the southern solar disk, while sunspots remain small and scattered.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
